headline: Andrea Kimi Antonelli capitalized on a sharp Mercedes pit strategy at Madrid to pass pole-sitter Lando Norris and claim a decisive victory.
whatHappened: Lando Norris led from pole through the opening stint on the tight Madrid street layout, keeping Andrea Kimi Antonelli under close pressure behind. Mercedes triggered the pit sequence early, undercutting Norris and handing Antonelli clean air to pull away. Max Verstappen executed a long second stint to pass Norris for second place late on, while track surface degradation contributed to key retirements for Lewis Hamilton and Carlos Sainz.
keyBattle: The pivotal moment came during the first pit window when Mercedes called Antonelli in early to undercut Norris. McLaren hesitated for two laps to clear backmarker traffic, which allowed Antonelli to lay down a blistering out-lap and steal track position before Norris emerged from the pits.
championshipImpact: Antonelli's win expands his championship lead over George Russell to 81 points with six rounds remaining. Lewis Hamilton's retirement deals a major blow to his title hopes, cementing Antonelli as the undisputed championship favorite.
watchThis: Observe how Antonelli prioritized smooth throttle application out of the low-speed sector two chicanes to preserve his rear tyres. This discipline gave him superior traction onto the front straight, rendering any DRS attacks behind him ineffective.
